description: The objective of this course is to develop the learning capabilities and hone the problem-solving skills of talented students at a mathematically deeper and more rigorous level. It is intended for students with strong mathematical inclinations and motivation. The emphasis will be on rigour, depth, and conceptual understanding. The contents of this course will consist of those in the regular course (MA2116/ST2131) and the following additional topics: Multivariate normal distribution, modes of convergence, Borel-Cantelli lemma, strong law of large numbers, moment generating functions and Fourier transforms of random variables, central limit theorem and Poisson limit theorem, basic large deviations.
